cases.sentence: Восемнадцать лет они угнетали израильтян на ___ Иордана в Галааде, в земле аморреев.
cases.explain: «восточной стороне» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

cases.sentence: Но вы оставили Меня и служили ___, и Я не стану больше спасать вас.
cases.explain: «другим богам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.

cases.sentence: Идите и взывайте к ___, которых вы избрали.
cases.explain: «другим богам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”

cases.sentence: Они избавились от ___ и стали служить Господу.
cases.explain: «чужеземных богов» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
